description:
Forced into a two-year contract marriage in place of her stepsister, who fell into a coma after an accident,

Geunyung agrees—under one condition.

[Special Clause: The contract ends if Lee Hyunjoo wakes up.]

They were just a couple on paper.

A temporary arrangement.

But everything starts to unravel when her husband, Tae Lee-Geon, begins to change.

"How about we actually get all over each other tonight?"

In the midst of confusion, fear, and a whirlwind of emotions,

Geunyeong finds herself heading toward the inevitable end of this marriage.

"Lee-Geon, you win. let's do it."

For the sake of a new beginning
